purpose: Locate the emitted rear trees and their removal openings before hardware installation.
inspection: The native branches and interfaces stand on the exposed rear exterior. They can be reached and withdrawn rearward before the nameplate, connectors and identification cards are installed. Both sliding grooves and the functional receiver, bore, socket and vent interiors contain no support paths.
scope: Native paths and geometric access; physical removal effort and surface finish remain observations of the finished print.
